$comment: STATUS-MODEL-01: one status model so Home, the robot and Go render the same colors and words. Owner decisions 2026-10-08: wording lives here first (tagged), paused and down are two states, search limited is its own amber state, every service uses the same model with {service} filled from one template, the composer line is long, and a child sees nothing on the profile menu while something is wrong. Additive: nothing here replaces an existing field. Copy has no em dashes. {service} is the display name the caller passes (default Chat). Rendering code lives in status/ts/statusModel.ts; a runtime without it reads this file and fixtures/status-model/*.json.
severity_note: Higher number is worse. The worst state wins a roll-up. unknown is 0 so it never outranks a known state.
sticky_note: sticky: stays until a person or the cause is fixed. Not sticky: clears by itself. paused is inside the recovery window; the backend reports the same cause as engine_failed after it, which is down.
cause_note: Structured, never parsed from prose. Each cause maps to exactly one state. A service takes the state of its worst cause; a tie keeps the cause listed first here.
surface_note: length picks the copy. summary true: the surface takes every status, colors from the worst severity and names the affected services in one sentence. summary false: it shows only its own service and never rolls up. hidden_from_child true: a child sees nothing there while any service has a problem.

summary.note: Affected means any state with problem true. Names sort by severity (worst first), then by code unit order, so every runtime builds the same sentence. One affected state: '<names> <predicate>'. Mixed states at short or medium: '<names> need attention'. Mixed states at long: one clause per state, worst first, joined with '; '. Four or more affected: short and medium use the collapse text; long lists. Medium and long end with a period, short does not.

starting.medium: Starting up. You can send in a moment.
starting.long: {service} is starting up. Your message stays here; you can send in a moment.

paused.medium: {service} is paused. Your message stays here.

down.medium: {service} is down. Your message stays here.
down.long: {service} is down and will not come back by itself. Your message stays here; press Send once it is fixed.

limited.long: {service} works, but some features are not available right now.

waiting_internet.long: {service} needs the internet and cannot reach it. It will go on when the connection is back.
